sources.excerpt: Sarcophagus | Black Arts Toneworks Menu Pedals News Swag Friends & Retailers Contact   Sarcophagus Sarcophagus The Sarcophagus takes two massive circuits and combines them into one unit, saving space, cabling and powering. The Pharaoh and LSTR are both present in the entirety with the addition of a toggle to reverse effect order. Pharaoh into LSTR or LSTR into Pharaoh. Built especially for the gain freaks, those who love more. More gain, more low end, more volume. A pedal of unruly proportions, taking your tone to the underworld. This pedal operates on a Standard 9VDC power supply. No battery connection. $375 © 2026 Black Arts Toneworks. All Rights Reserved.

Black Arts Toneworks (BAT) specializes in big, harmonically rich fuzzes and distortions built for doom, stoner, sludge, and heavy rock. Based in the USA, their pedals are designed to hit loud tube amps hard without losing low end or clarity. The Sarcophagus houses both the Pharaoh and LSTR fuzz circuits in one enclosure. You can run them independently or combine them for massive stacked fuzz that defined the Black Arts sound. The Pharaoh side offers versatility from clean boost to saturated fuzz with dual tone controls. The LSTR side delivers higher-gain Muff-style assault with more midrange cut. Together, they cover an enormous range of fuzz territory. Demo Videos Specifications Power 9V DC Current Draw ~50mA est.
